import Mathlib

theorem hermes_probe : (R : NegLogRectifier α β) {x y : α}
    (hx : R.positive x) (hy : R.positive y) :
    R.generate (x * y) = R.generate x + R.generate y := by
  trace_state
  sorry

surface.name: generate_mul
surface.tactic:
unfold generate
  rw [R.log_mul hx hy]
  abel
